negative_invariants.description: No sk-section-list, shadow ul/li, role=list or role=listitem is introduced.
No component derives feed ordering/freshness, status vocabulary, initials, time, selection, navigation or other application behavior.
No selected state is exposed as aria-selected/aria-pressed or checkbox/switch semantics; only controlled aria-current=true is allowed on the stable row root.
No non-repeat Enter/Space keydown is canceled and no custom keyboard activation path duplicates the native click.
No SC-009 claim or preventable default action is invented for the binding non-cancelable event.
No static markup form, second authored markup source, raw design value, new token or dependency is introduced.
No generated CEM/React/Vue/CSS/size output is hand-edited and no timestamped token catalogue is used as byte-determinism evidence.
No local screenshot or pre-baseline expected-red run is treated as approved visual evidence.
No shared-output reconciliation occurs on stale independent #145/#146 train tips.
No post-consolidation rebase/rebaseline is attempted after the held train SHA advances; the required state is BLOCKED.
No acceptance-writer commit is attached to reviews of its parent SHA; SK-178 requires same-head attestation or an explicit exact-SHA waiver.
No WP PR, closing keyword, main push/merge, package publish or deployment occurs in this mission.
